ABM.name: Third Party Billing
ABM.description: Creates claims for submittal to Medicare, Medicaid, and private insurance for eligible patients from PCC visit information — gathers and enters claim data from other RPMS applications.

ABSP.name: Pharmacy Point of Sale
ABSP.description: Provides a means for I/T/U facilities to perform online submittal of pharmacy claims, via a switch company, to third-party payers.

ACR.name: Administrative Resource Management System
ACR.description: An automated requisition and purchase order system, featuring electronic routing of documents for approval and signature, and an automated commitment register.

APSA.name: Benchmark Price Update
APSA.description: Provides calculations on prescription drugs, both brand names and generics.
APSA.restricted_note: Restricted distribution — submit a request through the IHS ServiceNow Self Service Portal using the OIT SQA RPMS File Request form

BAR.name: Accounts Receivable
BAR.description: Processes, manages, reports, and follows up on Accounts Receivable transactions related to all Third Party Billing activity, including payment tracking and accounting by category, aging reports, and statements.

BMX.name: BMXNet
BMX.description: A set of software utilities designed to enable Windows applications written using the .NET framework to exchange data with RPMS using standard ADO.NET tables.

BNI.name: Computerized Public Health Activity Data
BNI.description: Provides for the entry of public health activity being performed by clinicians or other providers of public health activities.

BNP.name: National Site Tracking
BNP.description: Allows you to see which RPMS packages are installed on any reporting site within the Indian Health Service.

BPRM.name: Practice Management Application Suite
BPRM.description: A comprehensive application to address IHS Practice Management business functions via pluggable modules. Browser-accessible GUI provides integrated workflows and consistent user experience for RPMS Practice Management applications.

BQRE.name: eCQM Export Tool
BQRE.description: Part of the two-component eCQM Reporting Solution for the 2018 Reporting Period and beyond. Exports RPMS data into QRDA CAT-I files for reporting or to the eCQM Engine (ECQM) for clinical quality measure calculation and QRDA CAT-III file creation.

BUSA.name: User Security Audit
BUSA.description: Enables advanced tracking of RPMS user activity to satisfy Meaningful Use II certification requirements. Contains a web-enabled reporting interface for filtering, sorting, and displaying logged data.

ECQM.name: eCQM Engine
ECQM.description: Calculates clinical quality measures from QRDA CAT-I files and generates QRDA CAT-III files for CMS submission. Part of the two-component eCQM Reporting Solution used starting with the 2018 Reporting Period.

GRU.name: Generic Retrieval Utility
GRU.description: Permits constructing and executing complex queries against FileMan databases using a graphical user interface. Results may be viewed, exported to external applications, or output in customizable report formats.

LEX.name: VA Lexicon Utility
LEX.description: VA clinical terminology lexicon utility. Uses the LEX namespace and also includes GMPT and ICPT routines called by other VA applications.

PIMS.name: Patient Information Management System
PIMS.description: Contains the Admission/Discharge/Transfer (ADT) application, the Clinic Scheduling application, and the Sensitive Patient Tracking (SPT) module.

TIU.name: Text Integration Utility
TIU.description: The VA Text Integration Utility automates clinic notes — managing clinical document templates, note titles, and the authoring/signature workflow.

ACHS.name: Contract Health Services
ACHS.description: Manages contract health service referrals and authorizations for care provided outside the IHS facility.

ACM.name: Case Management System
ACM.description: Supports case management workflows for tracking patient care plans and service coordination.

ACPT.name: Current Procedural Terminology
ACPT.description: Provides CPT code lookup and management for procedure coding in clinical documentation.

ADE.name: Dental Data System
ADE.description: Supports dental encounter documentation, charting, and reporting for IHS dental programs.

AG.name: Patient Registration
AG.description: Core patient registration system for enrolling and managing patient demographic information and eligibility.

AGMP.name: Master Patient Index
AGMP.description: Maintains a master index of patients across facilities to support patient matching and data linking.

AICD.name: ICD Lookup System
AICD.description: Provides ICD-10-CM diagnosis code lookup and management for clinical documentation and coding.

AMH.name: Behavioral Health System
AMH.description: Documents behavioral health encounters, treatment plans, and outcomes for mental health and substance use programs.

AMQQ.name: Q-Man
AMQQ.description: Ad hoc query and reporting utility for extracting patient data and generating custom reports from the RPMS database.

APCD.name: PCC Data Entry
APCD.description: Patient Care Component data entry module for recording encounter data including diagnoses, procedures, and provider information.

APCH.name: PCC Health Summary
APCH.description: Generates patient health summaries from PCC encounter data for clinical review and care coordination.

APCL.name: PCC Management Reports
APCL.description: Produces management and statistical reports from PCC data for program oversight and planning.

APCM.name: Promoting Interoperability Reports
APCM.description: Generates reports required for Promoting Interoperability (formerly Meaningful Use) program attestation and compliance.

APSP.name: IHS Pharmacy MOD
APSP.description: IHS-specific pharmacy modifications providing extensions and customizations to the RPMS pharmacy suite.

APSS.name: Pharmacy Rx Outpatient Automation Interface
APSS.description: Interface between RPMS pharmacy and outpatient automation dispensing systems.

ATX.name: Taxonomy
ATX.description: Manages clinical taxonomy definitions used for grouping diagnoses, procedures, and medications in reporting and alerts.

AUM.name: ICD Update
AUM.description: Manages annual ICD code set updates to keep diagnosis and procedure coding current.

AUPN.name: IHS Dictionaries — Patient
AUPN.description: IHS-specific patient data dictionary definitions and extensions used across clinical applications.

AUT.name: IHS Dictionaries — Pointers
AUT.description: IHS-specific pointer and reference dictionary definitions used across RPMS applications.

BADE.name: Dental/EDR Interface
BADE.description: Interface between the RPMS Dental Data System and Electronic Dental Record (EDR) systems.

BCDM.name: Chronic Disease Management
BCDM.description: Supports population-level chronic disease management programs with registries, alerts, and outcome tracking.

BCCD.name: Consolidated Clinical Document Architecture
BCCD.description: Generates and receives C-CDA documents for interoperability with external health information exchanges and systems.

BCER.name: Certified Electronic Record Checker
BCER.description: Validates EHR certification requirements and checks compliance with ONC certification criteria.

BCH.name: Community Health Representative System
BCH.description: Supports Community Health Representatives (CHR) in documenting home visits, health education, and community outreach activities.

BCQM.name: IHS Code Mapping
BCQM.description: Maps IHS-specific codes to standard terminologies (SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm) for interoperability and quality reporting.

BDM.name: Diabetes Management System
BDM.description: Manages diabetes patient registries, tracks HbA1c and other clinical indicators, and supports audit and control surveys.

BEDD.name: Emergency Department Dashboard
BEDD.description: Real-time dashboard for emergency department patient tracking, bed status, and throughput monitoring.

BEPC.name: Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances
BEPC.description: Enables DEA-compliant electronic prescribing of controlled substances (EPCS) with two-factor authentication.

BEPR.name: e-Prescribing Productions
BEPR.description: Supports Surescripts electronic prescribing network integration for routing prescriptions to pharmacies.

BEX.name: Pharmacy Auto Refill
BEX.description: Automates pharmacy refill processing and patient notification for outpatient prescription management.

BGP.name: Clinical Reporting System
BGP.description: Generates standardized clinical performance reports including Government Performance and Results Act (GPRA) measures.

BGU.name: IHS RPC Broker
BGU.description: IHS extensions to the VA RPC Broker providing client-server communication infrastructure for RPMS GUI applications.

BHS.name: Health Summary Components
BHS.description: Provides reusable health summary display components for assembling patient health summaries across RPMS.

BI.name: Immunization System
BI.description: Tracks patient immunization records, manages vaccine inventory, and supports reporting to state immunization registries.

BJMD.name: C32/CCD Clinical Summary
BJMD.description: Generates CCD and C32 clinical summary documents for patient care transitions and referrals.

BJPC.name: IHS PCC Suite
BJPC.description: Integrated Patient Care Component suite providing the core clinical encounter documentation platform for IHS facilities.

BJPN.name: Prenatal Care Module
BJPN.description: Documents prenatal visits, tracks pregnancy progress, and generates perinatal outcome reports.

BJVN.name: Joslin Vision Network
BJVN.description: Interface supporting diabetic retinopathy screening through the Joslin Vision Network teleophthalmology program.
BJVN.restricted_note: Restricted distribution — Joslin Vision Network agreement required

BKM.name: HIV Management System
BKM.description: Manages HIV patient registries, tracks clinical indicators, and supports Ryan White program reporting.

BLE.name: Electronic Laboratory Reporting
BLE.description: Transmits reportable lab results to public health authorities in HL7 format for disease surveillance.
BLE.restricted_note: Restricted distribution — state public health agreement required

BMC.name: Referred Care Information System
BMC.description: Tracks referrals and authorizations for care provided outside the IHS/tribal facility network.

BOP.name: Pharmacy Automated Dispensing Interface
BOP.description: Interface between RPMS pharmacy and automated dispensing cabinets (ADCs) for controlled substance tracking.

BPDM.name: Pharmacy — Controlled Drug Export
BPDM.description: Exports controlled substance dispensing data to state prescription drug monitoring programs (PDMPs).
BPDM.restricted_note: Restricted distribution — state PDMP agreement required

BPHR.name: Personal Health Record
BPHR.description: Patient-facing personal health record providing access to health information via the IHS patient portal.

BPM.name: Patient Merge
BPM.description: Merges duplicate patient records across the RPMS system. Superseded by AGMP Master Patient Index.
BPM.deprecated_note: Do not use for new implementations — use AGMP Master Patient Index instead

BREH.name: RPMS EHI Export
BREH.description: Exports Electronic Health Information (EHI) in compliance with ONC information blocking rules and 21st Century Cures Act.

BRN.name: Release of Information
BRN.description: Manages patient requests for release of medical records and tracks disclosure accounting.

BSTS.name: SNOMED/DTS
BSTS.description: SNOMED CT terminology server and Distribution and Terminology Services (DTS) interface for standardized clinical coding.

BTPW.name: Care Management Event Tracking
BTPW.description: Tracks care management events, patient outreach activities, and care coordination touchpoints.

BUD.name: Uniform Data System
BUD.description: Generates Uniform Data System (UDS) reports for HRSA-funded health centers on patient demographics and clinical quality measures.

BW.name: Women's Health
BW.description: Documents women's health encounters including family planning, cervical cancer screening, and reproductive health services.

BYIM.name: Immunization Data Exchange
BYIM.description: Supports bidirectional data exchange with state and regional immunization information systems (IIS).

BQI.name: iCare Population Management
BQI.description: Population health management tool for identifying care gaps, managing patient panels, and tracking preventive care measures.

CHIT.name: Consumer Health Information Technology
CHIT.description: Patient-facing consumer health IT applications including kiosk and self-service health information tools.

EHR.name: Electronic Health Record
EHR.description: Core EHR application providing the clinical desktop interface integrating all RPMS clinical modules for point-of-care documentation.

GIS.name: Generic Interface System
GIS.description: Generic HL7 interface engine for transmitting clinical data between RPMS and external systems.

GMRA.name: Adverse Reaction Tracking
GMRA.description: Records and tracks patient allergies and adverse drug reactions with clinical decision support alerts.

GMRC.name: Consult/Request Tracking
GMRC.description: Manages clinical consultation requests and tracks referral status between services and providers.

GMRV.name: Vitals/Measurements
GMRV.description: Records and displays patient vital signs and clinical measurements with trending and alert thresholds.

GMTS.name: VA Health Summary
GMTS.description: Generates VA-style patient health summaries integrating data from across RPMS clinical modules.

LR.name: Laboratory
LR.description: Full-featured laboratory information system supporting order entry, specimen tracking, results reporting, and microbiology.

MU2.name: Meaningful Use 2 Documentation
MU2.description: Documentation and attestation support for Meaningful Use Stage 2 program requirements. Superseded by APCM Promoting Interoperability.
MU2.deprecated_note: Superseded by APCM — use for historical reference only

PSJ.name: Pharmacy — Inpatient Suite
PSJ.description: Inpatient pharmacy management including unit dose dispensing, IV admixtures, and medication administration records.

PSN.name: Pharmacy — National Drug File
PSN.description: VA National Drug File providing standardized drug information, formulary management, and drug interaction checking.
PSN.restricted_note: Restricted distribution — VA NDF license required

PSO.name: Pharmacy — Outpatient
PSO.description: Outpatient pharmacy dispensing system managing prescription processing, refills, and patient medication profiles.

PXRM.name: VA Clinical Reminders
PXRM.description: Clinical reminder and decision support system for preventive care, disease management, and evidence-based guidelines.

RA.name: Radiology
RA.description: Radiology information system supporting order entry, exam scheduling, result reporting, and DICOM interface.

VEN.name: Well Child Component
VEN.description: Supports well child visit documentation, growth tracking, and developmental screening for pediatric care.

ADS.name: Distribution Management Package
ADS.description: Supports collecting license data from IHS RPMS installations. Periodically captures maximum concurrent users per server and sends data to a central repository for license administration and transparency between sites, areas, and OIT.

AVA.name: IHS VA Support Files
AVA.description: System patches that provide various aspects of support for VA FileMan in IHS's RPMS.

BDW.name: Data Warehouse Export System
BDW.description: Local export of registration and visit data to the IHS National Data Warehouse.

BCOM.name: IHS Communications Support
BCOM.description: Transfers files and information securely from sites to one or more central data repositories.

BFMC.name: FileMan-To-Cache Class Conversion
BFMC.description: Converts FileMan file definitions to InterSystems Cache classes. See also C32/CCD Clinical Summary (BJMD).

BHL.name: IHS Support for HL7 Interfaces
BHL.description: Provides a way for RPMS applications to exchange healthcare data with commercial off-the-shelf and other applications using the HL7 protocol.

BMW.name: RPMS/Ensemble Cache Classes Database File
BMW.description: Required component of several IHS RPMS applications. Contains the IRIS.DAT database with IRIS classes generated against FileMan files.

BXT.name: IHS Kernel Toolkit Extensions
BXT.description: IHS-developed extensions to the VA Kernel Toolkit application.

DI.name: FileMan v22
DI.description: VistA FileMan — the RPMS database management system. Creates and maintains a database management system on top of the MUMPS environment. See Kernel v8 (XU) for the latest patches.

HL.name: HL-7
HL.description: Assists DHCP applications exchange information with other applications using the HL7 protocol. Provides a generic interface to the HL7 protocol via a set of utility routines and files.

XB.name: IHS Utilities
XB.description: Utility routines used by RPMS developers.

XM.name: MailMan
XM.description: General purpose computerized message system for sending, receiving, copying, responding to, and organizing electronic mail within RPMS.

XT.name: Kernel Toolkit
XT.description: System application supporting Kernel. Supplements the Kernel software package with development tools, quality assessment tools, capacity management tools, and system management utilities. See Kernel v8 (XU) for the latest patches.

XU.name: Kernel v8
XU.description: Vendor-independent applications development and run-time environment providing standard services to application software. Executes in an M (MUMPS) environment. The authoritative location for latest Kernel and Kernel Toolkit patches.

XWB.name: RPC Broker
XWB.description: Remote Procedure Call (RPC) Broker — the common communications driver interface for client/server application data exchange between GUI clients and RPMS server.
